pit_execution_contract.decision_at: 15:30:00 Asia/Shanghai after completed session summaries and raw minute lifecycle are available
pit_execution_contract.holding_horizon_definition: hN enters at t+1 legal open and exits at the first legal open on or after t+1+N market sessions; h1/h2/h3 are independently estimable
pit_execution_contract.severe_loss10: minimum cost-aware low-mark return during the natural holding path <= -0.10

universe.history: at least 252 causal market-session rows and 120 prior finite amount-shock observations where required

price_limit_reopen_reseal_acceptance.hypothesis: after an upper-limit close is broken by at least one tick, a later reseal that persists into the close identifies accepted demand and favorable next-open-to-h2 economics
price_limit_reopen_reseal_acceptance.representation: continuous-session minute closes equal the historical upper-limit price; after first seal require a later close at least CNY0.01 below the limit, a subsequent reseal, and final close at the limit
price_limit_reopen_reseal_acceptance.score: final consecutive upper-limit minutes divided by continuous minutes from first seal through close
price_limit_reopen_reseal_acceptance.direction: higher acceptance score is favorable; all valid reopen-reseal events are signals, ordered by score then prior-20 amount then symbol
price_limit_reopen_reseal_acceptance.control: same-date simple-seal upper-limit closers with no one-tick reopen after first seal, ordered by deterministic SHA-256; controls never enter signal selection
price_limit_reopen_reseal_acceptance.portfolio_translation: up to 10 highest-score signals per date, equal capital, next legal open entry, fixed two-session hold

liquidity_shock_price_assimilation.hypothesis: when traded amount is unusually high relative to a security's own causal history, close/VWAP and close-location acceptance separates assimilated demand from activity without acceptance
liquidity_shock_price_assimilation.amount_shock: log(current amount / median amount over the prior 20 valid security sessions)
liquidity_shock_price_assimilation.shock_eligibility: current amount shock is at or above the causal trailing-252-session 90th percentile with at least 120 prior finite shocks
liquidity_shock_price_assimilation.raw_score: equal mean of same-date percentile ranks of close_vs_vwap and (close-low)/(high-low)
liquidity_shock_price_assimilation.signal_score: same-date residual of raw_score on an intercept and ranks of current action-safe return, daily range/preclose, and r20
liquidity_shock_price_assimilation.control: same-date shock-eligible names outside the selected top 20, ordered by deterministic SHA-256 with equal control count
liquidity_shock_price_assimilation.portfolio_translation: up to 10 highest-score signals per date, equal capital, next legal open entry, fixed two-session hold

replay.cohort_capital: up to one half of pre-entry NAV per signal date, bounded by cash, so a fixed two-session daily strategy supports two overlapping cohorts
replay.exit: first legal open on or after the fixed two-session due date under unchanged ASHARE-CA-REPLAY-003 risk-event handling
strategy_candidate_all_required: early and late returns each exceed named control
